title: ITS2 database curation parameters
description: Parameters for the ITS2 reference-database curation workflow.

custom_db.description: Required custom ITS2 reference database (.fasta, .fna, or .txt), emitted with the stable reference ID 'custom'.

custom_db_filter_pattern_exclude.description: Case-insensitive regular expression. Matching FASTA headers are excluded.

custom_db_include_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression. Only matching headers are kept in the final cleaned FASTA.

custom_db_max_length.description: Maximum sequence length for the final cleaned FASTA. Set to -1 for no maximum.

custom_db_max_consecutive_ns.description: Exclude a sequence when it contains a run of more than this many consecutive N bases.

fungal_screening_db.description: UNITE fungal FASTA database used by VSEARCH.

fungal_screening_identity.description: Minimum sequence identity required for a fungal match.

fungal_screening_query_cov.description: Minimum fraction of the query sequence covered by a fungal match.

fungal_screening_mincols.description: Minimum number of aligned columns required for a fungal match.

dereplication.description: Dereplicate exact sequences within each species or across the complete FASTA.

itsx.description: ITSx profile selection. T runs plants only. Any value containing F runs plants first and fungi second.

database_version.description: Version assigned to the curated database release.

reference_base.description: Base directory containing NCBI taxonomy references under <reference_base>/database_curation/<reference_version>/new_taxdump. Use it alone to install references or with --custom_db during curation.

reference_version.description: Version directory used for installed database_curation reference files.
